answer: Deterministic Falcon Beacon. Each epoch a verifiable random beacon assigns identities to random task cohorts; only cohort winners receive settlement rights, and assignment is unknown until the beacon opens. An attacker must create identities before the beacon reveals placement, so mass duplication gains no predictable advantage. Every identity also pays a fixed per-epoch registration cost in saffron credits, making each sybil a sunk expense. A pearl of withheld randomness is punished by exclusion.
